overloads.semanticRole: Called from within a trigger, the Trigger event command returns a numeric value that denotes the type of the database event, in other words, the reason why the trigger has been invoked.

constraints: Meaningful only when called from within a trigger; the return value denotes the database event that invoked the trigger: 0 outside any trigger execution cycle, 1 On Saving New Record Event, 2 On Saving Existing Record Event, 3 On Deleting Record Event.
Same event-code numbering as the dbEvent output parameter of TRIGGER PROPERTIES.
